extraction.method: Actual Tcl dbWireDecoder points; same-net same-layer collinear union. See scripts/EXTRACT_ODB.md.
limitations: Patch metal retained as rectangles, not fictitious centerline length
Special-wire boxes retained but centerline/via stats unavailable
Module-pair length is a whole-net total only for exactly two known modules, not branch attribution
Dedicated networks occupy exclusive summary categories
macro_interfaces.csv overlaps main category totals: each net with actual BLOCK* and CORE* endpoints contributes once per layer/category; never add this view to the main total
extraction.length_um_meaning: physical um = original DBU / dbu_per_database_um * physical_um_per_database_um; database_length_um retained separately

source.scope: Read-only derivative of existing final ODB extraction; no physical rerun.
